title: Machinery overlay (curated)
description: The hand-authored CURATION half of the machinery map (the 'visualised pseudocode'). Lives at research_os/render/machinery_overlay.json, committed. It declares the data-flow stages and maps load-bearing functions to them with a plain-language role + substrate tag. render/derive_machinery.py reads this and AST-grounds every unit in the real code (signature, line, docstring, call edges), then cross-checks for drift, emitting the DERIVED render/machinery_map.json (machinery_map.schema.json). This is NOT a canonical store object and is not referentially-closed by loop/validate.py — it references code paths, not store ids.

scope_files.description: Repo-relative files the derive scans for 'uncovered' drift — public module-level/method defs here that no unit covers. Keep this to the trust seams (the substrate paths) to keep the drift signal high.

stages.description: The ordered data-flow stages (the reading order of the pipeline).

units.description: The load-bearing functions, one per node. The derive enriches each with signature/line/doc/calls from the AST.

name.description: Function (or Class.method) name as it appears in `file`.

role.description: Plain-language one-liner: what it does in the pipeline.

substrate_component.description: The substrate component this function is part of ('propagator'|'surrogate'|'scorer'), or null. Drives the substrate highlight + the deep-link to /substrate.
